sources.title: Unemployment by sex and age – annual data (une_rt_a)
sources.metric: Unemployed people aged 15–74 as a percentage of the labour force, both sexes, annual LFS estimates
sources.method: Decode JSON-stat dimensions by their category indexes. Select DE, CH, DK, NO and 2016–2025; preserve source rates and flags without interpolation or aggregation. Dates YYYY-01-01 are plotting positions for full-year observations, not January measurements.
limitations: Source break flags: DK 2016, 2017, 2023; DE 2020. Comparisons across these boundaries require caution.
2015 is retained in the original response but excluded from this ten-year plot.
Annual results are not calculated here by averaging monthly rates.

sources.title: LFS main indicators – reference metadata
sources.method: Definitions, annual compilation and comparability documentation reviewed on retrieval date.

editorial_decision: One German 2016–2025 trend plot. Fresh Eurostat acquisition; Drive used solely to identify the existing topic. No Drive data, specifications, captions, code or images reused.
